headline: CheapCart announces a sale
summary: 20% off CheapCart packages for two days.
details: A neighbourhood promotion lowers package prices at CheapCart. The original price remains visible beside the effective price. Other active price effects can combine with this sale.

headline: Oats go viral
summary: Oat prices rise 50% across stores today.
details: A fictional online trend has increased demand for rolled oats. All offers for rolled oats cost more today. This popularity story is not evidence of a new health benefit; food classifications and ingredient appeal are unchanged.

headline: Verdant & Co. closes for maintenance
summary: The store is closed today. Pantry food is unaffected.
details: Scheduled maintenance closes Verdant & Co. for the day. You can still use ingredients already in your pantry. The store reopens tomorrow; another accessible store remains available.

headline: The bistro makes local news
summary: Two days of publicity plus a Verdant & Co. promotion.
details: A local feature brings temporary attention to the bistro. Morning attendance uses an additional 200 publicity points for two days. Earned popularity and ending scores are unchanged. Verdant & Co. also offers 10% off packages during the feature.

headline: CheapCart closes for restocking
summary: CheapCart is closed today. Pantry food is unaffected.
details: CheapCart is closed for a full restock today. You can still cook with what is in your pantry, or shop at another open store. CheapCart reopens tomorrow.
